title: GEPA eval dataset — Context → error → fix (T10 §4.2)
description: Schema v1 for the GEPA eval dataset of agent-desktop (v0.5 Skill Evolution). Every record has exactly the shape {id, context, error, fix, scenario, source{type, ref, harness_version}, severity, verified} (docs/skill-evolution-acceptance.md §4.2 FMT-1..5). Consumed by the T11 dataset builder (validation) and the T14 harness (scoring) — FMT-4: the same schema validates every record of a single JSON/JSONL dataset file with a declared schema version.

skill.description: Skill this dataset evolves (registry path; pilot: install-dsh).

built_at.description: Build timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC, ms). Overridable for reproducible builds (CG-1).

harness_version.description: T14 harness manifest version used for scenario classification (SRC-3).

context.description: What the agent was doing + environment facts needed to reproduce (FMT-1).

error.description: Exact failure: message / exit code / symptom (FMT-1, SRC-2 exact quote for error_log).

fix.description: The correct handling, verified — NOT just "retry" (FMT-1).

scenario.description: Scenario class from the T14 harness manifest (FMT-2 — unknown class fails validation).

verified.description: FMT-3: sandbox-pass = the fix passes the corresponding harness test; human-confirmed = owner/cto confirmed the fix (Q3 evidence). Unverified cases are excluded from the dataset.

type.description: Provenance tag (§4.1): sandbox_test = T14 harness test; error_log = real error log (DSH run logs / sessions.jsonl reflections / owner failure reports).

ref.description: Test case id (sandbox_test) or <file>:<line> (error_log) — SRC-1: must be verifiable at build time.
